火把音樂
詞／曲：林以樂、黃元貞、劉思捷

lines.a: 若非祢流出寶血贖回我
lines.b: Redemption by Your precious blood flowing

lines.a: 我怎能有機會重新來過
lines.b: The chance of new beginning possible

lines.a: 看見我所有罪惡和軟弱
lines.b: My sins and my weaknesses You see all

lines.a: 祢卻用完全的愛接納我
lines.b: Yet with perfect love You take all of me

lines.a: 雖然我曾有失信遠離過
lines.b: Once I was lost but I was found again

lines.a: 但祢信實仍緊緊抓住我
lines.b: Faithful You are, and never let me go

lines.a: 學會放手不再靠自己活
lines.b: I learn to live not by might nor by power

lines.a: 只誇耀祢一切為我所做
lines.b: And give all glory, all praises to You

lines.a: 唯獨倚靠祢 唯獨倚靠祢
lines.b: My trust is in You My trust is in You

lines.a: 無價的寶血 映出真實的我
lines.b: Jesus' precious blood reflecting my true self

lines.a: 多麼不等價的替換
lines.b: The most unfair exchange of all

lines.a: 唯獨倚靠祢 唯獨倚靠祢
lines.b: My trust is in You My trust is in You

lines.a: 成就永恆 堅定不移的約
lines.b: The covenant Promise is now fulfilled

lines.a: 天涯海角祢把我尋回 耶穌
lines.b: To the ends of the earth You found me, Jesus

lines.a: 因祢的寶血 恩典的寶血
lines.b: Oh through Your blood shed, amazing grace shown

lines.a: 修補一切 再次立約
lines.b: God reconciled us to Himself

lines.a: 因祢的寶血 犧牲的寶血
lines.b: Oh through Your blood shed, sacrificed for us

lines.a: 坦然無懼 到祢面前
lines.b: Boldly I come before the throne
